description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class PerformanceTrackerSearchFilterParams used within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It provides filtering and sorting parameters for searching performance tracker records, including an employee number filter and predefined sortable fields.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class extending FilterParams, used for searching performance tracker records with specific filters and sort options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the class with default sort field 'performanceTracker.modifiedDate' and descending order.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.
